datatype.name: Wmid
datatype.definition: The opaque, immutable machine identity of a node (the "ConceptId"): the literal prefix `wmid:` followed by a 26-character Crockford base32 ULID. It never changes, even across rename or re-translation; all machine references ultimately resolve through it. WML source currently addresses nodes by their QName `id`; the Wmid is the stable identity behind it.

provenance.note: Adopts the ULID spec (Crockford base32, 26 chars, time-sortable) as the opaque id.

datatype.name: QName
datatype.definition: A stable, human-readable qualified name addressing a WMOOP node: `<module>` (e.g. `wmoop.core`), `<module>/<TypeName>` (e.g. `wmoop.core/Speed`), or `<module>/<Type>#<member>`. Stable by policy (changed only via deprecation + alias). The meta-model also renders a human alias form `wm:{domain}:{LocalName}`.

datatype.name: DimensionExponent
datatype.definition: The integer exponent of one SI base dimension within a QuantityKind's dimension vector (e.g. −1 for Time in Speed = L·T⁻¹). Zero means the base dimension does not appear.

provenance.source: ISO 80000-1:2022 Quantities and units — Part 1: General

enumeration.name: ProvenanceKind
enumeration.definition: The closed set of ways a provenance record may be grounded. Mirrors the `kind` of a WML provenance entry (schema/wml.schema.json) so the kernel's Provenance type is self-describing.

value.definition: An empirical/factual claim backed by a resolvable external source (standard, paper, dataset).
A modelling or definitional choice that follows by definition; no external empirical source is claimed.
A naming or structural convention adopted by WMOOP.

concept.name: Provenance
concept.definition: A single provenance record attached to a node, property or fact: where the claim comes from and how it is grounded. Reifies the built-in WML `provenance:` object so the kernel defines the very type the meta-level uses (Invariant 4 — nothing is unsourced).

property.name: source
property.definition: The citation, standard, dataset or statement of origin for the claim.

property.name: kind
property.definition: How the claim is grounded (sourced / definitional / convention).

property.name: ref
property.definition: A locator within the source (clause, table, page, field).

property.name: url
property.definition: A resolvable URL for the source, where one exists.

property.name: note
property.definition: A short human note qualifying the claim (e.g. a scope narrowing).

concept.name: QuantityKind
concept.definition: A kind of measurable quantity (Length, Mass, Speed, …) characterised by its SI Dimension: a 7-vector of integer exponents over the SI base dimensions (L, M, T, I, Θ, N, J) = (Length, Mass, Time, ElectricCurrent, Temperature, AmountOfSubstance, LuminousIntensity). A derived kind (Speed, Area, Volume) also records its dimension formula. A property measured in some kind is typed by that kind and carries a `unit:` (meta-model §6.4).

provenance.source: BIPM, The International System of Units (SI), 9th edition (2019)
ISO 80000-1:2022 Quantities and units — Part 1: General

property.name: dimL
property.definition: Exponent of base dimension L (Length) in this kind's dimension vector.

property.name: canonicalUnit
property.definition: QName of the canonical (SI) Unit this kind's magnitudes reduce to.

property.name: derivation
property.definition: For a derived kind, its dimension formula over base kinds (e.g. Speed = Length · Time⁻¹). Absent for a base kind.

concept.name: Unit
concept.definition: A unit of measurement belonging to exactly one QuantityKind, with a linear conversion to that kind's canonical (SI) unit: canonical = factor · value + offset (the offset supports scales such as °C ↔ K). Units are first-class (meta-model §6.4, R5): a measured property names its Unit in `unit:`.

provenance.source: ISO 80000-1:2022 Quantities and units — Part 1: General
BIPM, The International System of Units (SI), 9th edition (2019)

property.name: symbol
property.definition: The unit's written symbol as used in `unit:` fields (e.g. `m/s`, `km/h`, `m2`, `cm3`, `degC`).

property.name: quantityKind
property.definition: QName of the QuantityKind this unit measures.

property.name: factor
property.definition: Multiplicative factor converting a value in this unit to the kind's canonical unit (`toCanonical.factor`).

property.name: offset
property.definition: Additive offset applied after the factor when converting to the canonical unit (`toCanonical.offset`; e.g. 273.15 for °C → K).

individual.name: Count
individual.definition: A dimensionless cardinal count of discrete entities.

individual.name: Length
individual.definition: Extent in one spatial dimension. SI base quantity L.

provenance.source: ISO 80000-3:2019 Quantities and units — Part 3: Space and time

individual.name: Mass
individual.definition: The amount of matter in a body. SI base quantity M.

provenance.source: ISO 80000-4:2019 Quantities and units — Part 4: Mechanics

individual.name: Time
individual.definition: Duration between events. SI base quantity T.

individual.name: Speed
individual.definition: Rate of change of position; a derived kind, Length per Time.

individual.name: Area
individual.definition: Extent of a two-dimensional surface; a derived kind, Length squared.

individual.name: Volume
individual.definition: Extent of a three-dimensional region of space; a derived kind, Length cubed.

individual.name: Temperature
individual.definition: Thermodynamic temperature. SI base quantity Θ.

provenance.source: ISO 80000-5:2019 Quantities and units — Part 5: Thermodynamics

individual.name: Angle
individual.definition: Plane angle; a quantity of dimension one, distinct in kind from Count.

individual.name: one
individual.definition: The unit one — the coherent unit of a quantity of dimension one (Count).

individual.name: m
individual.definition: Metre — the SI base and canonical unit of Length.

individual.name: kg
individual.definition: Kilogram — the SI base and canonical unit of Mass.

individual.name: s
individual.definition: Second — the SI base and canonical unit of Time.

individual.name: m_per_s
individual.definition: Metre per second — the coherent SI (canonical) unit of Speed.

individual.name: km_per_h
individual.definition: Kilometre per hour — a non-coherent unit of Speed used on road vehicles.

provenance.source: Exact conversion 1 km/h = 1000 m / 3600 s = 1/3.6 m/s

individual.name: m2
individual.definition: Square metre — the coherent SI (canonical) unit of Area.

individual.name: m3
individual.definition: Cubic metre — the coherent SI (canonical) unit of Volume.

individual.name: cm3
individual.definition: Cubic centimetre — a sub-multiple unit of Volume used for engine displacement.

individual.name: K
individual.definition: Kelvin — the SI base and canonical unit of thermodynamic Temperature.

individual.name: degC
individual.definition: Degree Celsius — a unit of Temperature offset from Kelvin by 273.15.

individual.name: rad
individual.definition: Radian — the coherent SI (canonical) unit of plane Angle.
